title: Model animation workshop
status: All model motion previews and all enemy death profiles implemented for review
scope: Model-specific enemy walk, run and flight; family-shared basic attacks across ranks I-VI; champion attacks and continuous support motion; one-shot enemy deaths.
sourcePolicy: Original approved deliveries remain unchanged. The workshop loads private instances and stores motion code and specifications separately.
deliveryStage: Local runtime previews for all140 models. Enemy deaths are integrated into the battlefield death event. Living locomotion and attack gameplay integration and baked production clips remain pending.

validation.basic: 48 actual rest skeletons and4896 phase checks: finite poses, fixed feet, exact loop/reset, zero reach clamps. Sixteen actual loaded I/VI release views inspected.
validation.enemies: 54/54 actual GLTFLoader instances passed six-phase articulation, finite geometry, deterministic seeking, exact reset and original-buffer preservation checks. Three running wolves and representative families visually inspected.
validation.champions: 38/38 actual GLTFLoader instances passed five-phase articulation, finite positions/matrices, exact position/normal/visibility/world-matrix reset and source preservation checks. Strong sword slash and all four opening dragon mouths visually inspected.
validation.limits: Working runtime animation prototypes require human motion/contact review. Checks do not certify full-cycle collision, route-aware foot locking, production skeletal rigs or baked clips. Living-motion gameplay integration remains separate from the completed enemy death event hookup.
validation.deaths: All54 IDs and family dispatch covered. Ten targeted death/integration/boss-scale tests passed; actual ground/flying Game damage-to-Battlefield death events verified. Eight actual browser death previews passed pose capture, final support, seeking and locomotion restoration; playback stops once and replays correctly.
validation.regressions: Two existing death/corpse-lifetime regressions passed. Vite production build passed. Approved V7 and V8 read-only lock checks passed with unchanged bytes.
validation.browser: 140 supported preview identities; five champion feedback captures; three running wolves; eight death profiles; zero JavaScript page errors. Report: qa-completion/browser-review.json
